chunks.title: Landmark Precedents in Human Rights Jurisprudence
chunks.content: # Landmark Precedents in Human Rights Jurisprudence

chunks.title: D.K. Basu v. State of West Bengal, (1997) 1 SCC 416
chunks.content:
### D.K. Basu v. State of West Bengal, (1997) 1 SCC 416
**Bench & Court:** Supreme Court of India (A.S. Anand, J.)
**Core Holding:** Formulated 11 mandatory guidelines for police personnel carrying out arrest and detention, including visible identification badges, arrest memo witnessed by family/friend, medical examination every 48 hours, and notification to police control room.

chunks.title: Nilabati Behera v. State of Orissa, (1993) 2 SCC 746
chunks.content:
### Nilabati Behera v. State of Orissa, (1993) 2 SCC 746
**Bench & Court:** Supreme Court of India (J.S. Verma, J.)
**Core Holding:** Established public law damages as an independent strict liability remedy under Article 32/226 for violations of fundamental rights by state authorities (custodial death), distinct from private tort remedies.

chunks.title: Procedural Practice Notes — Human Rights Inquiries
chunks.content: # Procedural Practice Notes — Human Rights Inquiries

chunks.title: NHRC Inquiries & Custodial Death Guidelines
chunks.content:
### NHRC Inquiries & Custodial Death Guidelines
1. **Reporting Within 24 Hours:** Mandatory reporting of any custodial death to NHRC within 24 hours followed by video-recorded post-mortem and magisterial inquest under BNSS §196.
2. **Standard of Compensation:** State compensation awarded ex debito justitiae without waiting for completion of criminal trial against errant police officers.

chunks.title: Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993 (PHRA)
chunks.content:
### Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993 (PHRA)
- **Section 12:** Functions of the National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) to inquire into human rights violations by public servants and intervene in court proceedings involving allegations of human rights abuse.
- **Section 18:** Recommendations for interim compensation and prosecution of guilty state officials.

chunks.title: Constitutional Protections (Articles 20, 21, 22)
chunks.content:
### Constitutional Protections (Articles 20, 21, 22)
- **Article 20(3):** Protection against self-incrimination.
- **Article 22:** Mandatory communication of grounds of arrest, right to consult counsel, and production before Magistrate within 24 hours.
